sections.title: Enable GDPR consent management (optional)
sections.summary: Toggle consent management to show a consent banner in regulated regions. You set the default consent state, banner text, and privacy policy URL, and consent decisions gate which events are collected.

sections.title: Choose the provider, then verify
sections.summary: Pick the analytics platform that matches your reporting workflow, then publish a test funnel and confirm events arrive in that provider dashboard within seconds.

sections.title: Track the funnel before scaling
sections.summary: Set up and verify analytics before publishing to traffic. Events are measured from the first visitor, so a destination added later cannot capture earlier sessions.
